FreeLang 컴파일러 Phase 4 구현 계획을 설계해주세요.

## 목표
string/bool 리터럴 파이프라인 완성 + REPL 구현

## 현재 상태 (탐색 결과)

### 치명적 단절
1. `ir/generator.go` genExpr()에 NodeStringLit, NodeBoolLit 케이스 없음
2. `ir.Operand` 구조체에 문자열 저장 필드 없음 (ImmVal은 int64만)
3. `vm.go` OpConst가 IsImm(int64)만 처리

### 관련 파일 위치
- `internal/ir/ir.go` - Operand 구조체 (IsImm, ImmVal만 있음)
- `internal/ir/generator.go` - genExpr() L335~356
- `internal/runtime/vm.go` - execInstrs() OpConst 처리 L69~75
- `main.go` - runCode() 재사용 가능

### 현재 Operand 구조체
```go
type Operand struct {
    IsTemp  bool
    Name    string
    IsImm   bool
    ImmVal  int64
    IsLabel bool
}
```

### 현재 IR Opcode
OpNoop(0) ~ OpSyscall(25) - 총 25개

## 구현 범위

### 1. ir/ir.go 수정
- Operand에 `IsStr bool`, `SVal string` 필드 추가
- Operand에 `IsBool bool`, `BVal bool` 필드 추가 (또는 IsImm으로 int64 0/1 활용)

### 2. ir/generator.go 수정
- genExpr()에 NodeStringLit 케이스: `Operand{IsStr: true, SVal: node.Value}`
- genExpr()에 NodeBoolLit 케이스: `true`→`Operand{IsImm: true, ImmVal: 1}`, `false`→`Operand{IsImm: true, ImmVal: 0}`
- genExpr()에 NodeStructLit 케이스 (선택)

### 3. runtime/vm.go 수정
- loadOperand()에서 `op.IsStr` 분기 → `StringVal(op.SVal)` 반환
- OpAdd에 string 연결 지원 (KindString + KindString → concat)
- OpEq/OpNe에 string 비교 지원

### 4. REPL (main.go 또는 신규 파일)
- `repl` 커맨드 추가
- `bufio.Scanner`로 stdin 줄 읽기
- 각 줄을 `runCode()`로 실행
- 이전 실행 globals 누적 (선택)
- `exit`/`quit` 종료

## 요청
각 단계의 상세 구현 스니펫과 예상 줄수를 포함한 계획을 작성해주세요. bool 처리 방법(별도 필드 vs int64 매핑)의 트레이드오프도 분석해주세요.

1	// Package ir defines intermediate representation for optimized AST
2	package ir
3	
4	// Opcode represents an intermediate representation instruction operation
5	type Opcode int
6	
7	const (
8		OpNoop Opcode = iota
9		OpConst
10		OpCopy
11		OpAdd
12		OpSub
13		OpMul
14		OpDiv
15		OpEq
16		OpNe
17		OpLt
18		OpGt
19		OpLe
20		OpGe
21		OpLabel
22		OpJump
23		OpJumpIf
24		OpJumpIfFalse
25		OpCall
26		OpParam
27		OpReturn
28		OpEnter
29		OpLeave
30		OpStructDef
31		OpFieldLoad
32		OpFieldStore
33		OpSyscall
34	)
35	
36	// Operand represents a value in an instruction (register, immediate, or label)
37	type Operand struct {
38		IsTemp  bool   // true if this is a temporary (t0, t1, ...)
39		Name    string // variable name or temp name
40		IsImm   bool   // true if this is an immediate integer
41		ImmVal  int64  // immediate value
42		IsLabel bool   // true if this is a label reference
43	}
44	
45	// Instruction is a three-address code instruction
46	type Instruction struct {
47		Op    Opcode
48		Dest  Operand
49		Src1  Operand
50		Src2  Operand
51		Label string // for OpLabel, OpJump, OpJumpIf, OpJumpIfFalse
52		Fn    string // for OpCall, OpEnter, OpLeave
53		Line  int    // source line number
54	}
55	
56	// Function represents a function in IR
57	type Function struct {
58		Name   string
59		Params []string
60		Body   []Instruction
61	}
62	
63	// Program represents a complete program in IR
64	type Program struct {
65		Functions []Function
66		Main      []Instruction
67	}
68	
69	// ByteSize returns the estimated byte size of the program (4 bytes per instruction)
70	func (p *Program) ByteSize() int {
71		count := len(p.Main)
72		for _, fn := range p.Functions {
73			count += len(fn.Body)
74		}
75		return count * 4
76	}
77

1	package runtime
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5	
6		"github.com/user/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/builtin"
7		"github.com/user/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/ir"
8	)
9	
10	// VM represents the FreeLang virtual machine
11	type VM struct {
12		program    *ir.Program
13		fnIndex    map[string]*ir.Function
14		callStack  []*CallFrame
15		paramQueue []Value
16		globals    map[string]Value
17	}
18	
19	// New creates a new VM for the given IR program
20	func New(prog *ir.Program) *VM {
21		vm := &VM{
22			program:    prog,
23			fnIndex:    make(map[string]*ir.Function),
24			callStack:  make([]*CallFrame, 0),
25			paramQueue: make([]Value, 0),
26			globals:    make(map[string]Value),
27		}
28	
29		// Build function index
30		for i := range prog.Functions {
31			vm.fnIndex[prog.Functions[i].Name] = &prog.Functions[i]
32		}
33	
34		return vm
35	}
36	
37	// Run executes the program and returns the result
38	func (vm *VM) Run() (Value, error) {
39		// Build label map for main
40		labelMap := buildLabelMap(vm.program.Main)
41	
42		// Execute main instructions
43		_, err := vm.execInstrs(vm.program.Main, labelMap, nil)
44		if err != nil {
45			return NilVal(), err
46		}
47	
48		return NilVal(), nil
49	}
50	
51	// DumpGlobals returns the global variables (for testing)
52	func (vm *VM) DumpGlobals() map[string]Value {
53		return vm.globals
54	}
55	
56	// execInstrs executes a sequence of instructions and returns the result
57	func (vm *VM) execInstrs(instrs []ir.Instruction, labelMap map[string]int, frame *CallFrame) (Value, error) {
58		pc := 0
59		var result Value
60	
61		for pc < len(instrs) {
62			instr := instrs[pc]
63			pc++
64	
65			switch instr.Op {
66			case ir.OpNoop:
67				// No operation
68	
69			case ir.OpConst:
70				// Load constant
71				if instr.Src1.IsImm {
72					result = IntVal(instr.Src1.ImmVal)
73					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
74				}
75	
76			case ir.OpCopy:
77				// Copy value
78				src := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
79				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, src, frame)
80	
81			case ir.OpAdd, ir.OpSub, ir.OpMul, ir.OpDiv:
82				left := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
83				right := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src2, frame)
84	
85				if left.Kind != KindInt || right.Kind != KindInt {
86					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("arithmetic operands must be int")
87				}
88	
89				var resultVal int64
90				switch instr.Op {
91				case ir.OpAdd:
92					resultVal = left.IVal + right.IVal
93				case ir.OpSub:
94					resultVal = left.IVal - right.IVal
95				case ir.OpMul:
96					resultVal = left.IVal * right.IVal
97				case ir.OpDiv:
98					if right.IVal == 0 {
99						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("division by zero")
100					}
101					resultVal = left.IVal / right.IVal
102				}
103				result = IntVal(resultVal)
104				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
105	
106			case ir.OpEq, ir.OpNe, ir.OpLt, ir.OpGt, ir.OpLe, ir.OpGe:
107				left := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
108				right := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src2, frame)
109	
110				// Ensure both are int for comparison
111				if left.Kind != KindInt || right.Kind != KindInt {
112					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("comparison operands must be int")
113				}
114	
115				var cmpResult bool
116				switch instr.Op {
117				case ir.OpEq:
118					cmpResult = left.IVal == right.IVal
119				case ir.OpNe:
120					cmpResult = left.IVal != right.IVal
121				case ir.OpLt:
122					cmpResult = left.IVal < right.IVal
123				case ir.OpGt:
124					cmpResult = left.IVal > right.IVal
125				case ir.OpLe:
126					cmpResult = left.IVal <= right.IVal
127				case ir.OpGe:
128					cmpResult = left.IVal >= right.IVal
129				}
130				result = BoolVal(cmpResult)
131				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
132	
133			case ir.OpLabel:
134				// Label definition (no-op, already in labelMap)
135	
136			case ir.OpJump:
137				if idx, ok := labelMap[instr.Label]; ok {
138					pc = idx
139				} else {
140					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined label: %s", instr.Label)
141				}
142	
143			case ir.OpJumpIf:
144				condition := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
145				if condition.Truthy() {
146					if idx, ok := labelMap[instr.Label]; ok {
147						pc = idx
148					} else {
149						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined label: %s", instr.Label)
150					}
151				}
152	
153			case ir.OpJumpIfFalse:
154				condition := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
155				if !condition.Truthy() {
156					if idx, ok := labelMap[instr.Label]; ok {
157						pc = idx
158					} else {
159						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined label: %s", instr.Label)
160					}
161				}
162	
163			case ir.OpParam:
164				arg := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
165				vm.paramQueue = append(vm.paramQueue, arg)
166	
167			case ir.OpCall:
168				args := vm.drainParamQueue()
169				retVal, err := vm.callFunction(instr.Fn, args)
170				if err != nil {
171					return NilVal(), err
172				}
173				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, retVal, frame)
174	
175			case ir.OpReturn:
176				if instr.Src1.IsImm || instr.Src1.Name != "" {
177					return vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame), nil
178				}
179				return NilVal(), nil
180	
181			case ir.OpEnter, ir.OpLeave:
182				// No-op (callFunction handles frame management)
183	
184			case ir.OpStructDef:
185				// No-op (type definition, no runtime effect)
186	
187			case ir.OpFieldLoad:
188				obj := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
189				if obj.Kind != KindStruct {
190					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("field access on non-struct")
191				}
192				offset := instr.Src2.ImmVal / 8
193				fieldKey := fmt.Sprintf("f%d", offset)
194				if val, ok := obj.Fields[fieldKey]; ok {
195					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, val, frame)
196				} else {
197					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, NilVal(), frame)
198				}
199	
200			case ir.OpFieldStore:
201				obj := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
202				if obj.Kind != KindStruct {
203					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("field store on non-struct")
204				}
205				offset := instr.Src2.ImmVal / 8
206				fieldKey := fmt.Sprintf("f%d", offset)
207				value := vm.loadOperand(instr.Dest, frame)
208				obj.Fields[fieldKey] = value
209				if frame != nil {
210					frame.Set(instr.Src1.Name, obj)
211				} else {
212					vm.globals[instr.Src1.Name] = obj
213				}
214	
215			case ir.OpSyscall:
216				// No-op (not implemented)
217	
218			default:
219				return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("unknown opcode: %v", instr.Op)
220			}
221		}
222	
223		return result, nil
224	}
225	
226	// callFunction calls either a builtin or user-defined function
227	func (vm *VM) callFunction(name string, args []Value) (Value, error) {
228		// Check for builtin function
229		if builtin.IsBuiltin(name) {
230			def, _ := builtin.Lookup(name)
231			rawArgs := make([]interface{}, len(args))
232			for i, a := range args {
233				rawArgs[i] = a.ToInterface()
234			}
235			result := def.Impl(rawArgs...)
236			return FromInterface(result), nil
237		}
238	
239		// Check for user-defined function
240		fn, ok := vm.fnIndex[name]
241		if !ok {
242			return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined function: %s", name)
243		}
244	
245		// Create new frame and push to call stack
246		newFrame := NewFrame(fn.Name, fn.Params, args)
247		vm.callStack = append(vm.callStack, newFrame)
248		defer func() {
249			vm.callStack = vm.callStack[:len(vm.callStack)-1]
250		}()
251	
252		// Build label map for function body
253		labelMap := buildLabelMap(fn.Body)
254	
255		// Execute function body
256		retVal, err := vm.execInstrs(fn.Body, labelMap, newFrame)
257		if err != nil {
258			return NilVal(), err
259		}
260	
261		return retVal, nil
262	}
263	
264	// loadOperand loads a value from an operand
265	func (vm *VM) loadOperand(op ir.Operand, frame *CallFrame) Value {
266		// Immediate value
267		if op.IsImm {
268			return IntVal(op.ImmVal)
269		}
270	
271		// Named value (variable or temporary)
272		if op.Name != "" {
273			// Try frame first (if in function)
274			if frame != nil {
275				if v, ok := frame.Get(op.Name); ok {
276					return v
277				}
278			}
279	
280			// Try globals
281			if v, ok := vm.globals[op.Name]; ok {
282				return v
283			}
284	
285			return NilVal()
286		}
287	
288		return NilVal()
289	}
290	
291	// storeResult stores a value to a destination operand
292	func (vm *VM) storeResult(dest ir.Operand, v Value, frame *CallFrame) {
293		if dest.Name == "" {
294			return
295		}
296	
297		// Store in frame (if in function)
298		if frame != nil {
299			frame.Set(dest.Name, v)
300		} else {
301			// Store in globals
302			vm.globals[dest.Name] = v
303		}
304	}
305	
306	// buildLabelMap builds a map from label names to instruction indices
307	func buildLabelMap(instrs []ir.Instruction) map[string]int {
308		m := make(map[string]int)
309		for i, instr := range instrs {
310			if instr.Op == ir.OpLabel {
311				m[instr.Label] = i
312			}
313		}
314		return m
315	}
316	
317	// drainParamQueue returns and clears the parameter queue
318	func (vm *VM) drainParamQueue() []Value {
319		args := make([]Value, len(vm.paramQueue))
320		copy(args, vm.paramQueue)
321		vm.paramQueue = vm.paramQueue[:0]
322		return args
323	}
324

22	func main() {
23		if len(os.Args) < 2 {
24			fmt.Println("Usage: freelang-evolving-compiler <command> [args]")
25			fmt.Println("Commands:")
26			fmt.Println("  lex <code>           - Tokenize code")
27			fmt.Println("  parse <code>         - Parse code to AST")
28			fmt.Println("  profile <code>       - Profile patterns in code")
29			fmt.Println("  report               - Show evolution report")
30			fmt.Println("  benchmark            - Run performance benchmarks")
31			fmt.Println("  compile <code>       - Full pipeline: parse->optimize->IR->codegen (soft mode)")
32			fmt.Println("  compile-strict <code> - Full pipeline with hard type checking")
33			fmt.Println("  run <code>           - Compile and execute code in VM")
34			return
35		}
36	
37		cmd := os.Args[1]
38	
39		// Commands without code argument
40		if cmd == "report" {
41			profileReport()
42			return
43		}
44	
45		if cmd == "benchmark" {
46			RunBenchmark()
47			return
48		}
49	
50		if len(os.Args) < 3 {
51			fmt.Printf("Command %s requires code argument\n", cmd)
52			return
53		}
54	
55		code := os.Args[2]
56	
57		switch cmd {
58		case "lex":
59			lexCode(code)
60		case "parse":
61			parseCode(code)
62		case "profile":
63			profileCode(code)
64		case "compile":
65			compileCode(code)
66		case "compile-strict":
67			compileCodeStrict(code)
68		case "run":
69			runCode(code)
70		default:
71			fmt.Printf("Unknown command: %s\n", cmd)
72		}
73	}

75	func lexCode(code string) {
76		l := lexer.New(code)
77		fmt.Println("=== Tokens ===")
78		for {
79			tok := l.NextToken()
80			fmt.Printf("Token(type=%v, value=%q, line=%d, col=%d)\n",
81				tok.Type, tok.Value, tok.Line, tok.Col)
82			if tok.Type == 0 { // TokenEOF
83				break
84			}
85		}
86	}
87	
88	func parseCode(code string) {
89		p := parser.New(code)
90		prog, err := p.ParseProgram()
91		if err != nil {
92			fmt.Printf("Parse error: %v\n", err)
93			return
94		}
95		fmt.Println("=== AST ===")
96		printAST(prog, 0)
97	}
98	
99	func printAST(node *ast.Node, indent int) {
100		if node == nil {
101			return
102		}
103		indentStr := ""
104		for i := 0; i < indent; i++ {
105			indentStr += "  "
106		}
107		fmt.Printf("%sNode(kind=%v, value=%q)\n", indentStr, node.Kind, node.Value)
108		for _, child := range node.Children {
109			printAST(child, indent+1)
110		}
111	}
112	
113	func profileCode(code string) {
114		p := parser.New(code)
115		prog, err := p.ParseProgram()
116		if err != nil {
117			fmt.Printf("Parse error: %v\n", err)
118			return
119		}
120	
121		collector := profiler.NewCollector()
122		collector.CollectFromAST(prog)
123	
124		patterns := collector.GetPatterns()
125		fmt.Println("=== Patterns Collected ===")
126		fmt.Printf("Total patterns: %d\n", len(patterns))
127		fmt.Printf("Build time: %d ns\n", collector.GetBuildTimeNs())
128	
129		topPatterns := collector.GetTopPatterns(10)
130		fmt.Println("\nTop Patterns:")
131		for i, p := range topPatterns {
132			fmt.Printf("%d. %s (count=%d, saved=%d ns)\n",
133				i+1, p.Signature, p.Count, p.SavedNs)
134		}
135	
136		// Save to database
137		dbPath := filepath.Join(".", "pattern-db.json")
138		db, _ := profiler.LoadFromFile(dbPath)
139		db.UpdateFromCollector(collector, code)
140		db.SaveToFile(dbPath)
141		fmt.Printf("\nDatabase saved to %s\n", dbPath)
142		fmt.Printf("Total builds: %d\n", db.TotalBuilds)
143	}
144	
145	func profileReport() {
146		dbPath := filepath.Join(".", "pattern-db.json")
147		db, err := profiler.LoadFromFile(dbPath)
148		if err != nil {
149			fmt.Printf("Error loading database: %v\n", err)
150			return
151		}
152	
153		fmt.Println("=== Evolution Report ===")
154		fmt.Printf("Total builds: %d\n", db.TotalBuilds)
155		fmt.Printf("Total patterns learned: %d\n", len(db.Patterns))
156		fmt.Println("\nTop Patterns:")
157	
158		topPatterns := db.TopPatterns(10)
159		for i, p := range topPatterns {
160			fmt.Printf("%d. %s (count=%d, saved=%d ns)\n",
161				i+1, p.Signature, p.Count, p.SavedNs)
162		}
163	
164		if len(db.BuildHistory) > 0 {
165			fmt.Println("\nBuild History:")
166			avgTime := db.AverageBuildTime()
167			latestTime := db.LatestBuildTime()
168	
169			fmt.Printf("Average build time: %d ns\n", avgTime)
170			fmt.Printf("Latest build time: %d ns\n", latestTime)
171	
172			if isRegression, ratio := db.DetectRegression(1.2); isRegression {
173				fmt.Printf("⚠️  Performance Regression Detected: %.2fx slower\n", ratio)
174			} else {
175				fmt.Println("✅ No performance regression")
